transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?
I came in because I’ve been having thoughts that my family might be better off if I just didn’t wake up. That scared me, so I told my supervisor.
Aside from those scary thoughts, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or empty lately?
I’m not sure I’d call it sad exactly. I’ve just been feeling off, I guess.
Have you noticed that you've lost interest or pleasure in the things you normally enjoy doing?

Yeah. I used to enjoy messing with my tomato plants, sanding wood at my bench, watching the Falcons, staying after church to talk with folks. Lately I just look at all of it like it belongs to somebody else.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
About two weeks now, since my daughter left Georgia for the military. It feels like that’s when this whole change in me started.
Have you ever experienced a period like this in your life before now?
Yeah, looking back, I’ve had these low stretches on and off for about a year. This one since my daughter left, though... it’s been the hardest one.
Have you ever had times where you felt unusually energetic, revved up, or needed very little sleep, feeling the exact opposite of how you feel now?

Yeah, there was a stretch where I had a lot of energy. I’d be up before daylight planning changes at the warehouse, then cleaning out the garage, bouncing from one thing to another. I just didn’t feel like stopping.
About how long did that period of high energy last?
It’s been about two weeks, since my daughter left Georgia for the military.
During that high-energy period, did you find you needed much less sleep than usual to feel rested?
I’m not really sure. I know I was sleeping differently, but I couldn’t tell you if it was less or not.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking energy during this low period?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed my energy being especially low.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or your weight recently?
Yeah. Most days I have to make myself eat just a few bites. Even food I usually like, at work or at home, just sits there until I end up throwing it out.
How has your sleep been over these past two weeks?
I’m not really sure how to answer that. I haven’t paid close attention to my sleep these past couple weeks.
Have you been having trouble concentrating, staying focused, or making everyday decisions lately?
Yeah. At the distribution center, I’ll stare at the schedule or routing sheet and just can’t get my mind to lock in. Little staffing decisions end up feeling a lot bigger than they should.
Have you been struggling with feelings of worthlessness or feeling excessively guilty about things lately?
Yeah. I keep going over my daughter leaving, telling myself I must’ve failed her somehow. Like if I’d been a better father, I would’ve done something different.
Have you or anyone else noticed that you are moving or speaking much more slowly than usual, or that you're so restless you can't sit still?
Yeah. People at work have been asking if I’m sick. I’ve been walking slower, and it takes me forever to answer even simple questions. It feels like my body’s moving through mud.
